theme.title: Rotation: Growth → Value & Defensives
theme.summary: Health Care (+1.65%) and Real Estate (+1.64%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-1.32%) and Energy (+0.16%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -0.00% versus +0.97% for defensives and +0.81% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.55%, Dow +0.79%, Nasdaq +0.55% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.50%. The VIX fell 3.50% to 14.88, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.40% to $4,218.90, crude oil was little changed at $91.75, and bitcoin gained 1.19% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
